links.outcome: Agreement between LLM answers and clinical findings in axSpA and PsA (Cohen's and Fleiss' Kappa)
links.effect: No agreement between clinical results and GPT-5 or DeepSeek-R1 by Cohen's Kappa; no satisfactory Fleiss' Kappa agreement; mean-value comparisons ranged from very good to large differences; overall moderate validity, reliability and utility.
links.quote: Regarding the results of the calculation of the Cohen’s Kappa coefficient, no agreement is indicated between the clinical results and the answers of ChatGPT and DeepSeek and specifically the GPT-5 and DeepSeek-R1 models.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic/treatment accuracy and reliability of ChatGPT and DeepSeek models against clinical data of 116 rheumatology patients without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
